{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Voting rights are fundamental rights because they are protective of all other rights.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to fully protect and enforce the fundamental Constitutional right of every American vote.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to fully fund the Help America Vote Act.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to fulfill the promise of election reform.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to fight to end long lines at voting booths.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to ensure that all registration materials, voting materials, polling places, and voting machines are truly accessible to seniors, Americans with disabilities, and citizens with limited English proficiency.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for a national standard for voting that includes voter-verified paper ballots.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for ensuring that absentee ballots are accessible and accurately counted.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to vigorously enforce voting rights laws instead of making them tools of partisan political agendas.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to laws that require identification in order to vote or register to vote, which create discriminatory barriers to the right to vote and disenfranchise many eligible voters.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to tactics which purge eligible voters from voter rolls.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to passing the Count Every Vote Act.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to enact legislation that establishes harsh penalties for those who engage in voter intimidation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to create a process for providing accurate information to misinformed voters so they can cast their votes in time.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
